kills.property: For any caller, a successful single Collect(...) call on the correct contract always decreases that caller's Acc(...).ba
kills.change_summary: Remove the require(!locked_) check from the nonReentrant_ modifier so reentrancy guard no longer prevents reentrant Collect calls, changing revert behavior under reentrancy.

kills.property: Reference contract preserves that a successful Collect call never allows the caller (or any reentrant attacker) to withd
kills.change_summary: Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier body to remove the require check, allowing reentrancy by not preventing reentrant entries.

kills.property: After any Put(...) call by any actor with any value, the contract's stored unlockTime for that actor is always >= block.
kills.change_summary: Change how acc.unlockTime is assigned in Put: always set to the provided _unlockTime (no max with block.timestamp), so callers can set unlockTime in the past which may affect whether Put reverts in some tests that expect non-decreasing unlockTime behavior.

kills.property: For every caller and payment value, calling Put(...) on the correct contract always triggers an external Log.AddMessage
kills.change_summary: Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call from Put so that Put does not make the external call to Log, which can cause Put to no longer revert when logging would revert.
